name: tasks-board
description: Docked right-hand pane showing a project's TASKS.md board: blocked on you, this session and in-progress work, merged with its other git worktrees.

baseBoard.title: Primary board path
baseBoard.description: Path template for the primary TASKS.md, with {org}, {repo} and {root}. Empty: the TASKS.md of the git main worktree of the session's directory, else the nearest one above it.

reposRoot.title: Repositories root
reposRoot.description: Value of {root} in the path templates.

repoPatterns.title: Repo path patterns
repoPatterns.description: Path templates, one per line or separated by semicolons, that derive org, repo and worktree name from the session's directory. Placeholders {root}, {org}, {repo}, {task}.

fixInstructions.title: Formatting agent instructions
fixInstructions.description: Extra rules appended to the prompt of the agent that rewrites a non-canonical board (workflow conventions, where scratch scripts go, how to wait for CI).

autofix.title: Offer to format boards automatically
autofix.description: When on, a non-canonical primary board is rewritten to the canonical format by a background agent that opens a pull request (at most once per repository per day). /board autofix on|off overrides this for a session.

excludeWorktreesOlderThanHours.title: Worktree boards: maximum age (hours)
excludeWorktreesOlderThanHours.description: Other worktrees whose TASKS.md changed longer ago than this are not merged into the board.

maxWorktrees.title: Worktree boards: maximum count
maxWorktrees.description: At most this many worktree boards (the newest) are merged.

ownerNames.title: Owner names
ownerNames.description: Names, separated by commas or semicolons, of the people whose decision a blocked row may wait on, besides "owner".

agentPrefixPattern.title: Agent name prefix pattern
agentPrefixPattern.description: A regular expression removed from the start of an agent name when it is shown (for example a date-stamped prefix).
